title: Scoring Dynamics and Mutual Reply Amplification in a Chronos-Interpreter Social Interaction Engine
topic: I Read X s Open-Source Algorithm: One Reply From a Mutual Is Worth 30 Likes
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We investigate a lightweight scoring engine that aggregates likes and replies on social posts, assigning a 30-point bonus to replies from mutual friends. The algorithm iterates over a list of interactions, filtering by post identifier and applying a constant-time weight per interaction type. We formalize the scoring invariant, prove its preservation, and analyze the asymptotic complexity of the core routine. The design is amenable to a balanced search structure for interaction lookup, yielding $O(\log N)$ search and insertion costs while maintaining $O(N)$ total scoring time. No empirical timing measurements are reported; the analysis relies on static abstract syntax tree inspection and formal reasoning. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261104_080123_i_read_x_s_open-source_algorit}
